title: First music: cousin's vaudeville show, Sidney Bechet and the Blue Devils
summary: The first music he remembers is his cousin's vaudeville show with Bechet, and he first met Basie with Walter Page's Blue Devils; he began playing professionally at 14.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: Do you remember the first music you heard?

First music I heard? I can remember, just about remember the first music I heard. My cousin had a vaudeville show and, well, he used to have -- he was much older, you know, and I was very small, and he used to bring that show to Sherman and he would perform like in the theater like for a week and he had Sidney Bechet.
Yeah, Sidney Bechet and comedians like Spider Bruce and I'm not sure, but I think Pigmeat was with one of his shows.

Pigmeat Markham. I know he remembers him very well, because I've asked him, you know, like in later years, if they knew Bruce -- his name was Bruson or Bruce. And I remember him having a nice little sounding band, couldn't have been anymore than eight. But then -- but I don't know if that was the first or not, because I -- you know, as I said, I was listening to other bands like Alphonso Trent. But I was older though when I listened to Alphonso Trent and the Blue Devils. That's when I first met Basie. He was with the Blue Devils, Walter Page's Blue Devils. But of course, I must have been about 12, 13 then. I started playing when I was 14.
